user.description: Solo la sorgente selezionata crea e aggiorna i sensori Home Assistant. L’inoltro cloud è indipendente. Le impostazioni avanzate richiedono indirizzi verificati della stazione fisica e del proxy.

data.trusted_sensor_proxies: Avanzate: IP dei proxy sensori attendibili
data.anonymous_station_address: Avanzate: IP della stazione fisica associata
data.legacy_anonymous_binding: Avanzate: associazione al dispositivo anonimo preesistente

data_description.dns_servers: Comma-separated DNS server IP addresses used for cloud forwarding.
data_description.sensor_source: Wunderground or Weathercloud. No automatic fallback or first-packet selection.
data_description.sensor_timeout: Default 900 seconds accommodates Weathercloud’s 10-minute interval. Missing fields expire independently.
data_description.trusted_sensor_proxies: Comma-separated numeric transport-peer IPs. Empty trusts no forwarding headers. Only one numeric X-Forwarded-For hop is accepted. Authentication is unchanged.
data_description.anonymous_station_address: Optional numeric IP representing exactly one physical station. Required for blank IDs and cross-protocol identity continuity.
data_description.legacy_anonymous_binding: Only enable after verifying that the existing anonymous device is the bound station. Rain and irradiance get new entities. History is not rewritten.
